purpose: Local Docker functional check of the new SP07 default (no env) and of the rollback via env: H2 harness 'default' policy (the image's own settings: breaker 2, Tech Info prefetch on, hard TTL from config), the gsp07-v2 harness arguments with --requests 6, variants m (no new release) and ep (new episode), seed 20261112; steady window = requests 2..5 (n = 4).
result: Default: hard TTL 86400 s; the soft-expired movie request is served from the old list in ~10.5 ms (the warm-path speed) and refreshed in the background. Env 0: the same request waits a synchronous tracker search (~440 ms), as before SP07. The episode missing from the old list is refreshed synchronously in both (~642 ms; lower than gsp07's 870 ms: here the Tech Info prefetch is on, in both gsp07 arms it was off, the likely reason, not measured separately). 3 tracker calls per stale request in every run, 0 external HTTP.
